title: What Is Hiding Beneath Antarctica’s Ice?
description:
Beneath kilometres of ice are lakes, mountains, valleys and volcanoes.

Antarctica hides hundreds of subglacial lakes, buried mountain ranges and active geological systems.

Radar, gravity and seismic measurements reveal terrain without removing the ice; liquid water can persist under pressure and geothermal heat.

Lake Vostok lies beneath roughly 4 km of ice.
